s: Which Persian ambassador visited the court of Deva Raya II?
x:
Abdur Razzaq, the Persian ambassador from the court of Shah Rukh of Persia, visited the Vijayanagara Empire in 1443–1444 during the reign of Deva Raya II. He praised Vijayanagara as one of the largest and richest cities in the world, describing its magnificent palaces, markets, military strength and prosperity. His account is one of the most valuable foreign sources for Vijayanagara history.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (2).

s: Who was the Italian traveller who visited South India during the reign of Deva Raya II?
x:
Nicolo Conti, the famous Italian traveller, visited South India during the reign of Deva Raya II in the early fifteenth century. He recorded valuable observations regarding the prosperity of the Vijayanagara Empire, its trade, temples, social customs and urban life. His travel account is an important historical source for the study of medieval South India.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (1).
